Package Reference

The pipeline consist out of multiple python scripts. Below is a brief description of the different scripts.

concept2pmid

Find PubMed Identifiers (PMIDs) based on provided free terms or fixed concepts.

pmid2meta

Search meta data of full scientific papers in OpenAlex.

meta2pdf

Download full scientific PDFs by using column pdf_urls from the metadata CSV file.

pdf2xml

Parse PDFs to TEI XML format.

xml2corpus_by_sentence

Process scientific TEI XML papers into a CSV file containing the corpus on sentence level.

corpus_by_sentence2vector

Transform a sentence-based corpus into vectors and calculate similarity scores.

similarity2graph

Create a networkx graph from a provided similarity matrix.
